next_step: Closed - security decline; will revisit after ISO27001 completion (no ETA).
notes: Account summary: Helix runs a chain of diagnostic labs and is highly regulated. Heavy emphasis on vendor attestations and unredacted artifacts for internal audit.

Initial discovery (2025-11-05): Jordan + Priya. Use cases prioritized: automated summarization of pathology reports, patient-facing chat triage, fast document search for clinical rules. Very latency-sensitive for report generation (95th pct <250ms preferred for summaries).

Tech deep-dive (2025-12-02): SE demoed dedicated routing + KV caching. Helix asked about VPC/private control plane, data residency in US regions. Positive reaction to Dedicated capacity for throughput predictability.
Security questionnaire submitted (2026-01-15): Helix sent 400+ Q vendor security spreadsheet. We returned completed questionnaire with SOC2 Type II report attached (redacted).

Security sync (2026-02-10): Attended by Helix InfoSec (Anika Rao, Head of InfoSec), Dir. of Procurement (Samir Patel), CTO (Dirk Vogel), Jordan, Priya. Key ask: ISO27001 certificate + unredacted SOC2 for internal audit. Quote from Anika: 'We cannot accept a redacted SOC2 for vendors who handle PHI-like clinical identifiers; ISO required per policy.'

Redaction impasse: We offered SOC2 Type II + redaction under NDA and a security controls walk-through (ff_20260210_helix_seccall). Helix refused to sign our standard NDA for unredacted report due to legal policy. They requested full vendor ISO certificate; Redwood does not yet have ISO27001.

Competitive pressure: MegaCloud AI submitted ISO27001 evidence and an unredacted SOC2 under Helix NDA; they also quoted a lower fixed monthly commit. Procurement favored vendor with complete artifacts.
Internal champion waning: CTO Dirk initially supportive but after procurement / legal pushback he paused advocacy. No exec-level sponsor to fight for waiver.

Procurement decision (2026-02-25): Helix closed in favor of MegaCloud AI citing 'complete compliance artifacts + faster onboarding'. Sec note: 'Redwood lacks ISO27001 and our compliance team will not accept the redacted SOC2.'
POC notes: We ran a small proof-of-concept in Dedicated: latency and throughput met targets (data in Drive: /proofs/helix_poc_summary). Performance not the issue. Security posture was the blocker.

Next steps suggested by AE: Flag as closed-lost; monitor ISO27001 program progress (we began ISO program Q4 2025). Re-engage 30-60 days after certification or if Helix policy changes. Log: INF-3145 for follow-up on SOC2 access requests.
CRM shorthand: closed-lost → security_req (iso gap) // internal_champ_down // competitor_won. Reopen conditions: ISO27001 cert OR willingness to accept redacted SOC2 + legal team OKs NDA.
